command:
set -eu
export CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=4 RUST_TEST_THREADS=4
git rev-parse HEAD origin/main
rustc --version
cargo --version
node --version
pnpm --version
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess, tempfile, textwrap
lines = Path('.github/workflows/test.yml').read_text().splitlines()
anchor = next(i for i, line in enumerate(lines) if 'oracle_args=(--base origin/main --ci --json)' in line)
start = next(i for i in range(anchor, -1, -1) if lines[i].strip() == 'run: |') + 1
end = start
while end < len(lines) and (not lines[end].strip() or lines[end].startswith('          ')):
    end += 1
with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(mode='w', suffix='.sh') as step:
    step.write(textwrap.dedent('\n'.join(lines[start:end])) + '\n')
    step.flush()
    subprocess.run(['bash', '-n', step.name], check=True)
print(f'revert-oracle step: bash -n PASS ({end-start} lines)')
PY
node scripts/check-rust-api-surface.mjs
node scripts/check-module-size.mjs
cargo test -p ifc-lite-processing --test module_size_ratchet --test function_length_ratchet --test positional_read_ratchet
cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
cargo test --workspace
node --test scripts/lib/module-size-ratchet.test.mjs
node scripts/check-test-revert-oracle.mjs --base origin/main --mutation tests/evidence/c4-10a/behaviour.oracle.patch --test rust/wasm-bindings/src/api/gpu_meshes/c4_10a_tests.rs --mutation tests/evidence/c4-10b/behaviour.oracle.patch --test rust/processing/src/execution_tests.rs --mutation tests/evidence/c4-10b/behaviour.adapters.oracle.patch --test rust/wasm-bindings/src/api/gpu_meshes/batch_tests.rs --mutation tests/evidence/c4-10b/policy.oracle.patch --test rust/processing/src/execution_tests.rs --verify-restored --ci --json
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --prefer-offline
pnpm fixtures buildingsmart/column-straight-rectangle-tessellation.ifc ara3d/AC20-FZK-Haus.ifc ara3d/duplex.ifc various/rvt01.ifc ifc5/Georeferencing_georeferenced-bridge-deck.ifc buildingsmart/Building-Architecture.ifc buildingsmart/wall-with-opening-and-window.ifc buildingsmart/annex_e/tessellated-shape-with-style/tessellation-with-pixel-texture.ifc buildingsmart/annex_e/tessellated-shape-with-style/tessellation-with-image-texture.ifc
pnpm fixtures --check buildingsmart/column-straight-rectangle-tessellation.ifc ara3d/AC20-FZK-Haus.ifc ara3d/duplex.ifc various/rvt01.ifc ifc5/Georeferencing_georeferenced-bridge-deck.ifc buildingsmart/Building-Architecture.ifc buildingsmart/wall-with-opening-and-window.ifc buildingsmart/annex_e/tessellated-shape-with-style/tessellation-with-pixel-texture.ifc buildingsmart/annex_e/tessellated-shape-with-style/tessellation-with-image-texture.ifc
pnpm build --filter=@ifc-lite/renderer... --filter=@ifc-lite/export...
CI=1 BUILD_RETAINED=1 bash scripts/build-wasm.sh
git restore -- packages/wasm/pkg-retained/.gitignore
contracts_log="$(mktemp)"
trap 'rm -f "$contracts_log"' EXIT
if pnpm test:wasm-contract >"$contracts_log" 2>&1; then
  python3 - "$contracts_log" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import sys,re,json,hashlib
raw=Path(sys.argv[1]).read_bytes()
s=raw.decode()
m=re.search(r"Results: (\d+) passed, (\d+) failed, (\d+) skipped",s)
assert m,"missing contract result summary"
passed,failed,skipped=map(int,m.groups())
skip_lines=[line.strip() for line in s.splitlines() if "SKIP" in line]
print(json.dumps({"wasmContracts":{"passed":passed,"failed":failed,"skipped":skipped},"skips":skip_lines,"fullLogSha256":hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()}))
assert passed>=231 and failed==0 and skipped==1,(passed,failed,skipped)
assert len(skip_lines)==1 and "matched historical fingerprint fallback" in skip_lines[0],skip_lines
PY
else
  cat "$contracts_log"
  exit 1
fi
git diff --exit-code origin/main -- packages/wasm/pkg/ifc-lite.d.ts packages/wasm/pkg-retained/ifc-lite.d.ts rust/wasm-bindings/src/api/gpu_meshes/batch_parity_expected.json
sha256sum packages/wasm/pkg/ifc-lite_bg.wasm packages/wasm/pkg-retained/ifc-lite_bg.wasm
git diff --exit-code
